Kuna Greenbelt Groove Fest to feature local music and food on July 25
B. P. Huynh
The City of Kuna announced on July 7 the upcoming Kuna Greenbelt Groove Fest, a family-friendly outdoor music festival scheduled for Saturday, July 25. The event will take place from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m. in the Kuna Greenbelt Area behind City Hall at the south end of Avenue E in Kuna, Idaho.
According to organizers, attendees can expect live entertainment from local artists on an outdoor stage, along with food and beverages available throughout the evening. The lineup includes Olivia Frost performing at 6:00 p.m., Wade Graves at 7:45 p.m., and The Orale! Band closing out the night starting at 9:45 p.m.
The festival is designed to appeal to a wide range of musical tastes, featuring genres such as soulful ballads, country love songs, and dance tunes. Organizers said that guests will be able to enjoy "amazing food" and "tasty beverages" while listening to performances.
More information about the event is available on the City of Kuna website.
